scope: Numbered Upplandsleden etapper 1-31 dedupe registry. Standalone slinga/loop files were added later and should be deduped against these canonical groups by source URL/coordinate during import.
integrationRules: Rows in section files remain section-scoped for provenance; importer should dedupe by this registry before creating visible facilities.
For shared endpoint facilities such as Kolarmoraån, Risön, Lövstabruk, Österbybruk, Skokloster, Häggeby, Almunge and Knutby, create one canonical place/facility and attach all relevant sectionRefs.
Keep parking and transit rows out of normal facility imports unless the app adds a dedicated access layer.
Do not promote suppressions, leakage rows, rule-warning rows or no-water/no-car metadata into visible facilities.
When a cluster contains multiple normal facility types at the same place, keep one canonical row per type under one shared place cluster.
Rows marked pending remain pending even if they sit inside a canonical cluster; do not import until the pending reason is resolved.
unresolvedQualityThemes: Commercial/seasonal services should remain pending unless current opening/access data is verified close to import time.
Standalone slinga/loop contribution files now exist; import should dedupe shared endpoint facilities against the numbered-etapp registry by source URL/coordinate.
